en: Born 1983 in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Lives and works in Paris, France.

Patricio Lima Quintana has exhibited at various galleries and institutions, including Kunsthalle Zürich (CH), C L E A R I N G Brussels, Paris Internationale, Fitzpatrick Gallery, Paris (FR); Rheum Room, Basel (CH); Anonymous Gallery, New York (US); suns.works, Zurich (CH); Galerie Bernhard, Zurich (CH); Freedman Fitzpatrick, Los Angeles (US); CACBM, Paris (FR); Pauline Perplexe, Arcueil (FR).
BA Industrial Design, Universidad de Palermo, Buenos Aires, Argentina
MFA Cinematography, Fundación Universidad del Cine, Buenos Aires, Argentina

Patricio Lima Quintana’s work explores the banality of existence. He investigates contemporary and historical contradictions with a deadpan approach. Through various mediums he creates work that’s seemingly familiar but ultimately uncanny. The result is a body of work developing new subversive narratives around social and moral themes. (Text excerpt: Cassidy Toner)
